name: hcapp_getMyKennelRunTotals
description: Returns the calling user's run totals broken down by kennel, plus an aggregate 'GRAND TOTAL' row. Calculated directly from HC.HasherEventMap (not from stored run count columns). @kennelId=null-UUID returns totals across all kennels.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Filter to a specific kennel. Default null-UUID = all kennels.

rowsets.name: RunTotals
rowsets.description: Per-kennel run totals ordered by rowNum (which is order of total runs, descending). The GRAND TOTAL row has rowNum=0 and KennelId=00000000... — it is always the first row.

columns.name: KennelId
columns.description: The kennel's ID. '00000000-...' for the GRAND TOTAL row.

columns.name: KennelLogo
columns.description: Kennel logo URL. '<no logo>' for the GRAND TOTAL row.

columns.name: KennelName
columns.description: Kennel name. 'GRAND TOTAL ALL KENNELS' for the aggregate row.

columns.name: totalRunsThisKennel
columns.description: Count of HC.HasherEventMap rows where AttendenceState >= 20, IsCountedRun=1, IsVisible=1.

columns.name: following
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.Following for the calling user at this kennel. 0 for GRAND TOTAL row.

columns.name: KennelShortName
columns.description: Kennel short name. 'TOTALS' for GRAND TOTAL row.

codeSmells.detail: Local variable declared as @timeWindows instead of @timeWindow.

codeSmells.issue: GRAND TOTAL row mixed into the result set with a null-UUID sentinel
codeSmells.detail: Callers must detect the '00000000-...' KennelId to identify the aggregate row. Better to return as a separate rowset or include an explicit isTotal flag.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change the GRAND TOTAL sentinel values (00000000... KennelId, 'GRAND TOTAL ALL KENNELS', 'TOTALS') without updating all callers
